bodyZh:
## 是什么
Kimi Code CLI 是面向开发者的终端 Agent，由 Moonshot AI 维护，直接支持 Kimi 模型，可在项目目录中读取与修改代码并使用工具。

## 快速使用
1. 按[上游安装指南](https://moonshotai.github.io/kimi-code/en/guides/getting-started)安装。
2. 进入项目目录，运行 `kimi`。
3. 通过 `/login` 选择上游文档支持的认证方式，再询问项目内容。

## 前提与限制
Windows 需要 Git for Windows。审核工具操作，把凭据保留在本机。本条目仅核对文档，未安装或实测软件。

## 出处

[上游 README](https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-code/blob/419aced0e97fa04b75f8f71b089e1667f6de6d0a/README.md)，核对版本 `419aced0e97fa04b75f8f71b089e1667f6de6d0a`。
bodyEn:
## What it is
Kimi Code CLI is a terminal agent for developers working in a project directory. Moonshot AI maintains it, and Kimi models are supported directly.

## Quick start
1. Follow the [upstream installation guide](https://moonshotai.github.io/kimi-code/en/guides/getting-started).
2. Open a project directory and run `kimi`.
3. Use `/login` to choose the authentication method documented upstream, then ask about the project.

## Requirements and limits
Windows users need Git for Windows as documented upstream. Review requested tool actions and keep credentials local. This entry was checked against documentation; the software was not installed or tested here.

## Source

[Upstream README](https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-code/blob/419aced0e97fa04b75f8f71b089e1667f6de6d0a/README.md), checked revision `419aced0e97fa04b75f8f71b089e1667f6de6d0a`.
